item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We need to be unequivocal: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. Preventing its creation is an urgent human-survival priority.

2. Superintelligent AI is not simply another powerful technology. If it is built in the next 20 years, at least a billion people will die. We must impose binding limits before an irreversible catastrophe occurs.

3. We reject the gamble that superintelligent AI can be built safely. If it is created within 20 years, the result will be catastrophic and at least a billion people will be killed. We must act now to prevent it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We do not believe this danger can be managed through ordinary safeguards, voluntary promises, or last-minute fixes. The stakes are too high for complacency, and the window to act is now. We are calling for binding limits that prevent the creation of superintelligent AI, backed by rigorous oversight and international cooperation. Our priority is simple: protect human lives before an irreversible disaster becomes reality. Technological ambition must never outrank the survival and security of humanity.
